task_summary: Distinguish a zero fan target after reboot from the unresolved earlier audible startup failure.

acceptance: Verify target initialization and S5 semantics against the flashed snapshot.

completed: Flashed snapshot initializes the target to zero and does not persist the earlier throttle; S5 changes launch state without setting a target.
Owner reported an impeller that can be turned unpowered and no fan response after reboot and S5.
A bounded query-only serial attempt completed with zero bytes and closed its port.
remaining: Current target, output and launch state were not received.

observations: Do not conflate a launch-enable button with a nonzero fan target.
A source-level zero default is not a measurement of current target or proof of healthy hardware.
Impeller hand rotation excludes only an obvious stationary jam, not every loaded mechanical or electrical fault.
Initial system port enumeration failed under restricted access; an authorized retry exposed one port. It opened but yielded no reply.

recommendations.action: During future fan diagnostics explicitly distinguish configured target, run gate, requested output and observed rotation.
